recent = trips[(trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 91) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 121)]

# Calculate daily fleet performance by class
daily_stats = recent.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

daily_stats['yt_per_angler'] = daily_stats['yt'] / daily_stats['anglers']
daily_stats = daily_stats.sort_values('fish_date_doy')
